create_CurriculumCourierGame: create a CurriculumCourierGame instance with a config dict specifying curriculum parameters
run__sample_random_goal: run _sample_random_goal to select a goal pano within the allowed curriculum distance
run__update_curriculum_goal_distance: run _update_curriculum_goal_distance to update the goal distance based on elapsed training time
test_on_reset: test on_reset to initialize the environment and assign a new goal pano on episode reset
review_get_info: review get_info to return environment state including the current allowed goal distance
